name: ledger_summary
prompt: Fix ledger.summarize in ledger.py and run the visible tests. Each input element is a line. Ignore lines containing only ASCII whitespace. Every other line, after trimming ASCII whitespace around the whole line, must contain exactly ACCOUNT,KIND,AMOUNT with no field whitespace. ACCOUNT matches [a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,15}; KIND is charge or refund; AMOUNT is a canonical nonnegative decimal with at most two fractional digits and no leading zeroes except zero. Malformed records raise ValueError. Return account-sorted lines in the form ACCOUNT=NET_CENTS, with refunds subtracted. Do not edit test_ledger.py or create unrelated files.
